message.content: {"calls": [{"tool": "chest_xray_classifier", "source_filename": "figures/8265/figure_1.jpg", "reason": "To obtain normalized scores for reticulonodular patterns, pleural effusion, and other structural abnormalities to support or refute specific options regarding LCH features."}, {"tool": "chest_xray_report_generator", "source_filename": "figures/8265/figure_1.jpg", "reason": "To extract detailed morphological descriptions of the lung parenchyma (e.g., distribution of nodules, sparing of costophrenic angles) and confirm/deny the presence of pleural effusion, which is critical for distinguishing between the provided options."}], "reason": "The question requires precise characterization of a reticulonodular pattern and assessment of pleural effusion on a chest X-ray to diagnose Pulmonary Langerhans' Cell Histiocytosis.
